name: Ceuta
summary: Black and white triangles radiating from the centre (gyronny), with the Portuguese coat of arms. It is the flag of Lisbon, kept from Ceuta's period under Portugal.
origin: Portugal conquered Ceuta in 1415 and gave it the flag of Lisbon. It passed to Spain after the Iberian Union, but kept the Portuguese symbols.

symbols.name: Portuguese arms
symbols.description: The arms of Portugal with the castles and quinas.

facts: Ceuta is a Spanish city on the North African coast.
Its flag shows the arms of Portugal, not Spain.
clues: Black and white triangles meeting at the centre, with the arms of another country.
A Spanish city on the African coast.
